destinations.name: Kangaroo Island
destinations.coordinates_source: Wikipedia Kingscote article point (island's main town and ferry-linked hub); centred on Kingscote so Cape Borda, Remarkable Rocks and Cape Willoughby all lie within 75% of the span

name_evidence.source: Wikivoyage 'Kangaroo Island' page and the Tourism Kangaroo Island board (tourkangarooisland.com.au)
name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage has a Kangaroo Island destination page covering Penneshaw, Kingscote, American River and Parndana; the board organises destinations around the island (West End, Penneshaw and Dudley Peninsula).

spots.bio: Kangaroo Island's flagship national park on the west end, home to Remarkable Rocks, Admirals Arch and wildlife, with an entry fee.
spots.name: Flinders Chase National Park
spots.note: Kept: Wikivoyage and agency: Kangaroo Island's flagship national park (Remarkable Rocks, Admirals Arch, wildlife) with an entry fee; a place in its own right. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: Wind-sculpted granite boulders on a dome of rock above the Southern Ocean that visitors can walk among.
spots.name: Remarkable Rocks
spots.note: Kept: Wikivoyage See: wind-sculpted granite formations you can walk among, Flinders Chase; headline draw. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A rock arch at Cape du Couedic, reached by boardwalk and steps, with a New Zealand fur seal colony beneath.
spots.name: Admirals Arch
spots.note: Kept: Wikivoyage See: rock arch with New Zealand fur seal colony reached by boardwalk and steps in Flinders Chase; headline draw. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: Home to an Australian sea lion colony, which visitors see on the beach on guided tours.
spots.coordinates_source: candidate point from the Wikipedia article for the park; re-pin to the visitor centre
spots.name: Seal Bay Conservation Park
spots.note: Kept: Wikivoyage See: Australian sea lion colony with guided beach tours, daily; headline draw. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: Show caves in Kelly Hill Conservation Park, visited on guided tours.
spots.name: Kelly Hill Caves
spots.note: Kept: Wikivoyage lists Kelly Hill Caves show-cave tours (daily, fee) in Kelly Hill Conservation Park. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A long white-sand bay on the south coast with a jetty, and a stop on south coast tours.
spots.name: Vivonne Bay
spots.note: Kept: southaustralia.com and Wikivoyage: long white beach once voted among Australia's best, jetty, south coast tour stop. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: Large white sand dunes on the South Coast Road where visitors go sandboarding.
spots.name: Little Sahara
spots.note: Kept: Wikivoyage Do: Little Sahara sandboarding dunes on the South Coast Road. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A lighthouse at Cape du Couedic near Admirals Arch, with the remains of storerooms and a flying fox a short walk away.
spots.coordinates_source: candidate point from the Wikipedia article (named lightstation/park point); re-pin with resolve-pin.py
spots.name: Cape du Couedic Lighthouse
spots.note: Kept: Wikivoyage lists it under Lighthouses and the board names it with Admirals Arch; remains of storerooms and flying fox a short walk away. Exterior only, but a guide-singled-out landmark. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: An 1858 lighthouse on the island's north-west cliffs, visited on tours.
spots.coordinates_source: candidate point from the Wikipedia article (named lightstation/park point); re-pin with resolve-pin.py
spots.name: Cape Borda Lighthouse
spots.note: Kept: Wikivoyage lists the 1858 Cape Borda Lighthouse with tours; remote but a named lightstation to visit. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A walk-through wildlife park near Parndana where kangaroos come up to visitors.
spots.name: Kangaroo Island Wildlife Park
spots.note: Kept: Wikivoyage See: walk-through wildlife park near Parndana with kangaroos coming to visitors. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A multi-day walking trail along the south and west coast through Flinders Chase, with campsites on the route.
spots.name: Kangaroo Island Wilderness Trail
spots.note: Kept: Named by the tourism board as a well-known multi-day trail through Flinders Chase (a Great-Walk style long trail, campsites on route); a long trail is a spot. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A beach reached through a boulder cave tunnel, with rock pools at low tide.
spots.name: Stokes Bay
spots.note: Kept: Tourism board: beach reached through a boulder cave tunnel, rock pools; named Australia's best beach 2023. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.
